entities.summary: Steamships which transported intellectuals expelled from soviet union in 1922; mainly 2 german ships, oberbürgermeister haken and preussen, which transported >160 russian intellectuals and their families in sept.–nov. 1922 from petrograd to stettin Based in Russian Socialist Federative Soviet Republic.
